scenes.vo: At three oh seven A M, I had a missed call. From my own number.
scenes.cap: 3:07 AM. A missed call. From my own number.

scenes.vo: There was a voicemail. It was my voice. Whispering. Don't answer the door.
scenes.cap: A voicemail. My voice, whispering: "Don't answer the door."

scenes.vo: I laughed. Some kind of glitch. Then someone knocked. Three slow knocks.
scenes.cap: I laughed. Then: three slow knocks.

scenes.vo: Through the peephole, the hallway was empty. But the hallway light was on. That bulb has been dead for a month.
scenes.cap: Hallway empty. But the dead bulb was on.

scenes.vo: Then my phone lit up in my hand. Outgoing call. To my own number. I wasn't touching the screen.
scenes.cap: Outgoing call. To my own number. I wasn't touching it.

scenes.vo: The time on the screen said three oh seven. And I heard myself start to whisper.
scenes.cap: 3:07 AM. And I heard myself whisper...
